name: Municipal Truck Parts Inc
about:
Municipal Truck Parts Inc was founded in 1996 in Cheshire, Connecticut, and operates as an independent aftermarket truck parts retailer. The business is closely tied to the Davidson family, which contributes three generations of combined truck parts knowledge to the operation.

The company stocks a broad range of parts for trucks from one-ton capacity and up, including brakes, batteries, filters, exhaust, fluids, lighting, wipers, welding supplies, belts, fasteners, and safety equipment. A notable service is the on-site assembly of custom hydraulic, air, fuel, oil, and brake hoses, as well as battery cables, which are fabricated while the customer waits. Municipal Truck Parts also provides free daily delivery within a 25-mile radius of its Cheshire location.

Its customer base includes truck dealerships, independent repair shops, municipal fleets, and private companies throughout Central Connecticut. The firm represents a curated selection of manufacturers to ensure product quality and reliability.

Municipal Truck Parts emphasizes its deep product expertise and a single-call sourcing model that aims to deliver the best combination of product, price, and service. The company’s longevity and focus on immediate hose fabrication are presented as key differentiators in the local market.
